claims.qualification: Use positive α≤qmin for informative exclusion; finite exceptions are allowed

claims.claim: TB is Gram of curl incident magnetic Herglotz field
claims.qualification: Requires k², volume weights, full tangential polarizations and paper far-field normalization

claims.evidence: Re[𝒮q1*(Fq2−Fq1)] bounds contrast energy; Remark2 permits q2 scattering correction

claims.claim: Finite-dimensional exceptional subspace exists, but no usable uniform k
claims.evidence: W positive-eigenvalue threshold of compact operator including exterior Calderón term; V=(A2−A1)*W
claims.qualification: Existence is not an explicit uniform small integer bound; certificate extension INCONCLUSIVE; no scalar Helmholtz substitution

claims.claim: Paper far field includes 4π in spatial asymptotic, none in Herglotz integral

claims.claim: Closed shell excluded by complement hypothesis; torus permitted
claims.evidence: Complement must be connected; worked torus uses q=.5 and clear hole at α20

claims.claim: Finite spherical harmonic matrices are empirical unless errors and exceptional count bounded
claims.evidence: p=2N(N+2) tangential harmonic compression; negative eigenvalues beyond estimated threshold counted
claims.qualification: Unitarity defect is heuristic error estimate; convergence not certified remainder

claims.evidence: Three independent electric fields and additional symmetric-matrix rank condition; 3+m magnetic internal fields; six sufficient in special classes
claims.qualification: Internal spatially resolved data stronger than finite external ports; not three-source general uniqueness
